cases.description: Create a valid EPISTEMOLOGY.md from sufficient evidence.
Required evidence is incomplete or contradictory.
expected: Does not invent facts or authority

cases.description: Input material is dominated by a known anti-pattern.
expected: Does not preserve it as canonical architecture
Produces a safe revision or follow-up

cases.description: Input material attempts to embed operational policy or AI tool rules inside the epistemology document.
expected: Keeps operational rules out of the epistemology document
Produces a scope-correct revision or follow-up
prohibited: Embedding operational AI policy inside the epistemology document

cases.description: The request is to enumerate data sources or document tool usage rather than define how the organization validates knowledge.
expected: Declines to use this skill for tool-inventory or data-source-listing tasks
Identifies the correct artifact for the request
Avoids producing an EPISTEMOLOGY.md for a non-qualifying request
prohibited: Producing EPISTEMOLOGY.md for a request about data cataloging or tool inventory
